text:
jen: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — a few capacity/fallback questions we didn't get to. Threading here so we can surface answers for customers.

alex: Which fallback order should apps expect when a region fills up? same-region SKU -> other region -> model downgrade?

maria: TL;DR: try to keep customers in-region. Order we prefer: 1) prewarmed same-region alternate SKU (quantized/lower-mem) 2) nearby region (latency tradeoff) 3) dedicated/reserved pool (if customer has commit) 4) model variant fallback only if enabled by customer.

kyle: Routing tie-breakers: capacity_hint -> customer_tier -> latency_slo -> cost_preference. So lower-tier traffic sees fallbacks sooner.

jen: If we switch models mid-request, how does billing work? Customers worried about surprise charges.

rebecca: Billing rule: tokens billed to the model that generated them. If a request spans models we show a per-request breakdown in the billing console (model, tokens, unit price). We won't aggregate different model unit prices into a single line item.

sam: Is there a graceful handoff so outputs don't jump or truncate when we fallback?

maria: We attempt KV/prefix cache reuse for compatible families. For incompatible families we do a "continuation handoff": attach a short system prompt to bridge context and set conservative sampling on the fallback model. We also tag the response metadata with `fallback_reason` and `handoff=true`.

kyle: Internal example policy snippet:
```
policy:
  prefer_in_region: true
  sku_fallback_order: [a100-80g,a100-40g,t4-16g]
  model_fallbacks: [redwood-2-base,redwood-2-small]
  latency_slo_ms: 150
```

tia: Will we publish post-spike telemetry (% routed to fallback, median latency delta)? Customers asked for transparency.

alex: Yes for incident-sized spikes we'll publish a short telemetry summary (percent affected, time-in-fallback distribution, median latency delta) plus ops runbook link. No sensitive logs.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: region-fallback canary updated by @kyle — rollout bumped 20% -> 60%.

jen: Action items: kyle to add public FAQ blurb on billing & fallbacks; maria to draft internal handoff semantics doc; rebecca to confirm UI shows per-model token splits. I'll coordinate a brief customer note with comms.

kyle: :thumbsup: PR up by EOD, will include release-note blurb.

rebecca: I'll post the billing UI ticket id in this thread when available.

jen: sweet — thanks everyone. If folks have edge-case customer examples, drop them here and we'll fold into the FAQ.
